analysis_disclosure: The preregistered primary contrast was Gemini/E4; scored Gemini/E4 is paused after a zero-error dev ceiling. Qwen is the preregistered REPLICATION judge; every scored Qwen contrast is exploratory-primary (judge substitution due to ceiling). Gemini/E5, if scheduled, retains preregistered harm contrasts A-W and F-U. This is the preregistered pause plus the cheapest judge that showed error opportunity in dev, not model shopping for a positive result. New dev gates must pass; pre-Amendment-8 Qwen evidence is historical only.

gemini_e4_dev_ceiling.interval_note: Descriptive judgment-level binomial Wilson interval; repeated items/arms are dependent, not 112 independent templates. No efficacy inference.
